_note: Provenance for every local skill and vendored tool in this repo: where it came from, what was adapted, and what is not yet proven.

ltx-production-writer.created_by: Claude, on the owner's instruction, as the sole writer for stages 04f and 04f3
adaptation: De-channelised: every number (clip duration, spoken-word band, aspect, cast rules, style echo) is read from channel_profiles/<slug>/channel.json rather than hardcoded, so one skill serves both channels.

Split into a two-pass shape (04f draft -> 04f2 stills -> 04f3 final) to resolve the circular i2v dependency the source repo leaves unresolved: its channel_prompt_constraints.md section 0 declares a video-first loop, while its skills run image prompts at stage 7 before video prompts at stage 8, and the stage-8 skill then instructs the author to write the opening clause 'AFTER the still is approved'. Both cannot be true in a single linear pass.
Added the frame-0 requirement block as an explicit, validated artifact (LTXV-S001/S002) rather than an implicit expectation.
Dropped the 'Continue from the still:' prompt opener: it is a relay-era habit that reads as meta-instruction, and the vendor guidance for i2v is to open on shot scale and subject.

Every inherited rule is graded [A] vendor-confirmed / [B] sibling-render-validated / [C] retest-required in pipeline/LTX_I2V_CONTRACT.md, because the source file warns in its own header that its 'render-validated' claims come from a sibling channel rather than from itself.
ltx-production-writer.not_render_validated: EP001 (signed-anyway) rendered a full 29-clip LTX-2.5 batch on 2026-10-29, settling research section 6 question 4 (img_compression) and the cfg/artifact tradeoff. This writer's prompt-density, dialogue-occupancy and multi-speaker rules remain unproven -- see pipeline/research/LTX25_PROMPTING_RESEARCH.md section 6 for what the next pilot batch must still settle.

frame0-still-writer.created_by: Claude, on the owner's instruction, as the sole writer for stage 04f2
adaptation: Input inverted: the still prompt is derived from the clip prompt's frame-0 requirement block (04f), not authored independently ahead of it.
De-channelised: reads style tokens, safety floor and cast rules from channel.json.

Generation path left model-agnostic rather than hardcoding the source repo's Meta Model API browser-automation route (--ref-asset / --skip-ref-tags / --project-id), which is that repo's own tooling and is not vendored here.

Output filenames are the clip id SC<NN>.png; the render app's app/batch.py (C:\pycode\app-vidgen-dist) matches a still to its clip by the scene number PREFIXING the filename stem (SC07 -> clip 7). Corrected 2026-10-29: this entry previously said 'LAST digit run', an earlier matcher the app no longer uses.
frame0-still-writer.upstream_vendor_source: Meta Muse Image prompting guide (dev.meta.ai/docs/image-generation), via the source repo's muse_image_still_constraints.md authority hierarchy

ltx_prompt_validator.design_note: LTX-2.5 native prose has no sections, no subject labels and no timing syntax, so the validator checks prose-level and state-level rules rather than a field structure. Two rules (LTXV-D024, LTXV-D041) shipped with false positives on ordinary prose that only the negative test cases exposed; a negative case is now required for any fuzzy rule.

image_agent_packet.adaptation: Ported as tools/image_agent_packet.py, with two upstream defects fixed and one addition. FIXED 1: the position extractor matched LEFT/RIGHT/CENTER case-insensitively, so an environment string containing 'frame-left' claimed the LEFT slot and every scene in the reference episode reported 'LEFT = warm late-afternoon sunlight' instead of a character. Position markers are now matched case-sensitively against the documented caps convention and must follow 'on the'/'at'/'is'. FIXED 2: only the FIRST match per slot was kept, which silently hid a real second claim. ADDED: a frame-0-forward check line per clip, listing that clip's touched_objects, which the upstream could not produce because its image stage ran before any video prompt existed.

storyboard.adaptation: Ported as tools/storyboard.py, deliberately simplified: one self-contained HTML file, a responsive card grid, stills embedded as data URIs, per-clip prompt and dialogue. Reads this repo's prompts/ and renders/ artifacts rather than the source repo's episode layout.

ltx25-prompting.source: global skill, invoked via the Skill tool
ltx25-prompting.role: Read-only conformance check AFTER compilation, never a drafter.
ltx25-prompting.note: Not vendored locally. If it disagrees with pipeline/LTX_I2V_CONTRACT.md, the contract wins — it is a generic vendor-syntax guide and does not carry this pipeline's render-validated findings.
